Name: Unskippable Events
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod removes the "Skip" button from every event, effectively making all events (including modded ones) unskippable. You will have to watch the entire event to proceed. If you can't stop yourself from skipping every event, this mod will stop you instead.

This does not take any context into consideration. Every event is unskippable, full stop. Is it almost 2am? Do you have a fish to go catch? Just about to give someone a gift? Too bad. You will watch the event.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Unskippable Events
Manifest.Description: Completely prevents you from being able to skip events.
